text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from buying refreshments 
for Phalaenopsis's juniors in the club...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What's that?

text_block_list.name: Local Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
Festival is underway~! 
The special prize is none other than a 
'Hot Springs Trip Voucher'!

text_block_list.name: Local Merchant
text_block_list.text:
First prize is a 'Special Deluxe Carrot 
Hamburg Steak'! 
Second prize is a 'Mound of Carrots'! 
Third prize is 'One Whole Carrot'!

text_block_list.name: Local Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all, to our fun, fun 
raffle! 
Step right up, anyone can play~!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. It seems the raffle tickets 
we just received can be used here.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A true test of fortune to open the new 
year. 
Do you fancy your luck?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha! An honest one, aren't you. 
Yet this year may smile upon you, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Care to test it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Very well. I expect great things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling her expectant gaze upon my back, 
I turned the handle of the raffle drum!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Local Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulaaations!! 
We have a winner for the Special Prize, 
the 'Hot Springs Trip Voucher'~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Obtained <itemname>.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Well, well, what have we here?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Splendid indeed, I must admit! 
You possess quite the remarkable luck of 
the draw!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I shall rely upon you 
whenever testing my fortune in the future.
choice_data_list: It might just be a fluke today, though...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: There is no need to be so timid.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If we succeed, it is thanks to your good 
fortune. 
If we fail, the responsibility lies with 
me for entrusting it to you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the grand prize was a hot spring 
trip voucher, was it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs are wonderful. Ideal for 
recuperation. 
They wash away any accumulated fatigue.
choice_data_list:
Then I want you to use the ticket, 
Phalaeno!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis is pushing her body the 
hardest right now. 
If a hot spring could soothe that fatigue, 
even if only a little—!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Goodness, you truly are something.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I only just told you, did I not? 
This reward was drawn forth by your own 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
In short, it is your achievement. 
It is not something I should take from 
you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Still unwilling to yield, are we?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
............Very well, I understand. 
Let us do this for now, then.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I shall hold on to this for safe keeping.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Saved for an auspicious day yet to come. 
How does that sound?
choice_data_list:
...All right. You can use it whenever you 
want.

...All right. You can use it whenever 
you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes, I gladly accept.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I entrusted the winning hot spring 
voucher 
into Phalaenopsis's care.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Staff
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, First Prize! 
The prize is a 'Special Deluxe Carrot 
Hamburg Steak'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Obtained '<itemname>'.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oho, first prize! 
Well done indeed!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A 'Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg 
Steak'...! 
I hear it was crafted by a truly skilled 
chef.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Fufu...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was she truly that delighted 
to win a carrot hamburg steak? 
Seeing Phalaenopsis break into a broad 
smile makes me smile, too.
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see you so happy.
I'm glad it brought you joy.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am glad. 
A stroke of good fortune has descended 
upon you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Lady Luck is surely on your side 
this year. 
It will undoubtedly be a wonderful year.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I am so very glad. 
Forgive me, Trainer, but may I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A warm palm is placed upon my shoulder 
twice, 
with a gentle pause in between.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...A truly splendid result. 
You did wonderfully.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her face as she praises me, I 
realize. 
It isn't winning the carrot hamburg steak 
that brought her such joy.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us share this feast we have 
obtained. 
Tonight promises to be an exceptional 
dinner.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come, before it cools. 
—Let us partake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, 
I took my seat across the table from 
Phalaenopsis 
to share the meal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Across from me, Phalaenopsis 
watched me with an unbroken smile upon her 
face.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Staff
text_block_list.text:
Second Prize!! 
The prize is a 'Mountain of Carrots'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Obtained <itemname>.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: A splendid draw.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet with such a vast quantity, 
how best to consume it before it spoils? 
I find myself at a loss.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
"Carrots!" "Thank you, Phaleno-san!" 
"Are there any more carrots!?" 
"Can we eat as much as we want!?"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha, pay it no mind. 
There are plenty of carrots to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Phalaenopsis's gaze, 
the cardboard box is... completely empty.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
When there were so many just a moment 
ago... 
Goodness me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Judging by Phalaenopsis's expression, 
this was wholly unexpected. 
After all, she had won a veritable 
mountain of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Yet far more new horsegirls had joined 
Phalaenopsis's club 
than she had anticipated. 
Enough to make an entire mound of carrots 
vanish.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... 
Must I procure additional nourishment at 
once? And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I retrieve the bag I left in our vehicle. 
Inside were extra carrots I had bought 
beforehand, 
just in case.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Well now.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You have impressive foresight. 
Splendid handling, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Because I have a wonderful master.
Because I have a wonderful master.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh? 
Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It seems I, too, am blessed with a fine 
disciple.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside everyone from the club, 
we happily carried on with our carrot 
feast.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Third prize~! 
The prize is "one single carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Obtained <itemname>.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Fufu, even one is still a win.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now, what will you do with this singular 
carrot? 
It is your reward. Do with it as you 
please.
choice_data_list: Then I want to give it to you, Phaleno.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. 
That is your reward, not mine. 
Do not offer up everything you receive.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Then I shall accept only "half."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a crisp snap, Phalaenopsis breaks the 
carrot in two, 
and holds out one half toward me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Now, how shall we put this carrot to 
use? 
What will you do with yours, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Deep-frying is fine, as is roasting. 
Eating it just as it is would also be an 
option.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Let it nourish you, however you choose.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you didn't win! 
The consolation prize is "pocket tissues"~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Obtained <itemname>.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
......Forgive me. 
Because I urged you on, I gave you 
unnecessary expectations.
choice_data_list: No, it's just that my luck is bad...
No, it's just that my luck is bad...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No, that is not so. 
Do not be so downcast.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
First and foremost, I was the one who 
asked you to draw. 
I am the one who dragged you into these 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...So please, do not look so disheartened. 
I am sorry.
